Hi all — quick technical answers below (happy to expand in the tech deep-dive). I’m happy to be the questionnaire owner and will prepare a draft response this week.

1) Export / streaming:
- Hosted API: we provide scheduled bulk exports (daily/hourly) to customer S3 buckets and managed BigQuery exports. For near-real-time SIEM ingestion, we offer a streaming integration on Redwood Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted customers can set up hourly exports + ingestion pipeline into Splunk; near-real-time pushes require Dedicated/Private or a log-forwarder addon.

2) Schemas and logged fields (examples):
- Admin activity logs: timestamp, actor_email, actor_role, actor_ip, action_type (e.g., user.create, key.rotate, model.deploy), resource_id, request_id, change_summary, audit_trace_id.
- API request logs: timestamp, request_id, client_api_key_id (hashed), user_agent, client_ip, request_path, response_status, token_count_in, token_count_out, response_digest (SHA256). Request bodies are not stored by default for privacy; we can log request_body_hash for correlation.

3) Retention & immutability:
- Default retention (hosted): 365 days for audit logs; adjustable for Dedicated (configurable to customer needs).
- Long-term archival: export to customer-owned S3 with lifecycle policies for 7+ years.
- Immutability / WORM: for fully tamper-evident storage, we recommend Private deployment (on-prem or VPC) with WORM-enabled S3 buckets or an HSM-backed write-once policy. For Dedicated customers we can offer an append-only backed storage model and signed digests (HMAC) for records to provide tamper-evidence; we can also stream digests to an external ledger service.

4) Compliance & reports:
- SOC 2: Redwood is currently in formal SOC 2 Type II audit (in progress) with expected completion in Q3 2025. We can share the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA once available; SOC 2 Type I documents are already available.
- HIPAA: we do offer BAAs for enterprise customers on Dedicated and Private deployments; for hosted customers we evaluate on a case-by-case basis — legal will need to review scope.

Attachments I’ll produce for the questionnaire: Audit_Log_Specs.csv (field-level schema), Security_Answer_Summary.md (plain-text Q&A).

Proposed next step: 30-minute technical deep-dive with MedApps to walk through export flow and immutability options. Hannah — can you propose 3 slots? I’ll join.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Staff Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Audit_Log_Specs.csv
